name: start-qai-shop
description: Testowy sklep internetowy na potrzeby szkolenia QA/AI (monorepo: React + Express + Prisma/SQLite).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @qai-shop/backend && npm run build --workspace @qai-shop/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @qai-shop/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @qai-shop/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @qai-shop/backend && npm run test --workspace @qai-shop/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @qai-shop/backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @qai-shop/frontend
